scenario.name: Test: distcc remote command execution (attacker + target)
scenario.author: Thomas Shaw
scenario.description: Two-VM test scenario for the agentic pipeline's tier-3 (exploit) testing (Phase 1C). A Debian 12 target runs the vulnerable DistCC daemon (CVE-2004-2687); a Kali/MSF attacker sits on the same private network. The distcc_exec module's secgen_test drives Metasploit's exploit/unix/misc/distcc_exec from the attacker against the target over the Proxmox QEMU Guest Agent and proves remote code execution. Both systems share a 10.88.0.0/24 private network (logical VLAN 1): IP_addresses[0] 10.88.0.10 is the target, [1] 10.88.0.20 is the attacker.
